Name: Simple Conversations
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]✦ Simple Conversations ✦[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💬 Features[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Keep talking after normal dialogue runs out, without a daily cap on added conversations. Original greetings and other mods’ authored dialogue keep priority.
• [b]3,877 entries for 34 original villagers[/b]: 3,857 character-specific entries and 20 shared observations.
• Everyday and friendship writing unlocks at [b]0, 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 hearts[/b]. Earlier tiers stay available; every villager has ten added lines at eight hearts and ten at ten hearts. Native friendship caps still apply.
• Seasonal dialogue and observations respond to weather, time and recent activities. Festival conversations cover before, during and after 12 festivals and gatherings, with after-festival lines tied to attendance.
• Saved repeat memory favours unheard lines across days and reloads, including shared lines heard from other villagers. Three fresh individual lines are favoured per fresh shared line when both pools are available; finite pools eventually repeat.
• Optional conversation and roaming emotes. With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53536]Simple Town Chatter[/url] installed, priority is On by default: SC extra dialogue continues while SC decorative emotes stay disabled. Turn priority Off to allow those emotes.[/color]

[center][size=5][color=#C084FC][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Dialogue and settings in all 12 game languages. Dialogue was translated line by line using ChatGPT, with character voice and conversational context in mind. The 680 added lines received a separate model-assisted review.
English · 한국어 · 简体中文 · Español · Português brasileiro · Русский · Türkçe · Deutsch · Français · 日本語 · Italiano · Magyar[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙ Settings & Use[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Talk to villagers normally. Optionally assign [b]Extra chat[/b] to a keyboard/controller button; it starts unassigned. Use Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json to toggle dialogue categories and emotes, or exclude individual villagers. The added high-friendship everyday lines use the Everyday category.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]🛠 Requirements & Install[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional.
Extract SimpleConversations into Mods. For updates, close the game, retain config.json and replace the older mod folder. The main download covers original villagers; SVE and Ridgeside dialogue packs are separate.[/color][/size][/center]
